name: Bolloré SE
summary: Bolloré SE engages in the transportation and logistics, communications, and industry businesses in France, rest of Europe, the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, and Africa. The company operates through Bolloré Energy, Communications, and Industry segments. It is involved in distribution and warehousing of oil products, as well as domestic fuel oil and transport and other diesel. The company also engages in the publishing and distribution of pay and free TV and production; sale and distribution of cinema films and TV series; design and release of downloadable video games on mobile devices and consoles; ticketing and venue services; communications consulting and advertising agencies; magazine sales;…
